audience: Spanish freelancers and small businesses that invoice with Quipu

useCases.title: Check which invoices are unpaid or overdue
useCases.text: List the invoices of an account by payment status and contact. Ask the assistant for the total that clients still owe.

useCases.title: Add up the invoiced amounts of a quarter
useCases.text: List the issued invoices of a period and read the totals with VAT and IRPF retention. Ask the assistant to sum them for a tax return.

useCases.title: Review the account history of one client
useCases.text: Find a contact by tax id or name. Read its paid and unpaid totals, then list the invoices of this contact.

useCases.title: Add a new client as a contact
useCases.text: Create a client contact from the name, tax id and email of a new customer. Update the contact later when its data changes.

useCases.title: Prepare a draft invoice for a client
useCases.text: Find the numbering series and the contact. Create a draft invoice with the lines for the work done. You finalize the draft in the Quipu app.
